final_objective.what_system_does: Bob transforming into 24/7 living organism: market-aware trading, XP-based reinforcement learning, pain memory, and continuous lifecycle loop. Phase 1 foundation implemented: market_hours, xp_system, lifecycle, and XP integration in feedback_loop.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 building autonomous Bob that learns by doing, suffers losses, reflects, and evolves 24/7.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Bob now has market detection, XP tracking, and lifecycle states. Phase 2 will add pain memory, auto-calibration, and reinforcement learning loop.
final_objective.proof_output: market_hours.py detects US market phases, xp_system.py tracks levels and pain factors, lifecycle.py manages 24/7 states, feedback_loop.py integrates XP for all closed trades.

what_was_done: Created ROADMAP_BORG_ORGANISM.md with 5-phase plan: Foundation (Phase 1), Reinforcement Learning, Reflection Committee, Auto-Execution, Interface/Monitoring.
Implemented market_hours.py: US Eastern timezone detection, NYSE/NASDAQ hours, pre-market/after-hours, holiday calendar, market state caching.
Implemented xp_system.py: XP levels (Novice to Grandmaster), pain factors (1x/2x/5x for losses), trauma flag (> $500 losses), streak bonuses, lesson applied bonus.

Implemented lifecycle.py: 24/7 loop with states (MARKET_CLOSED, PRE_MARKET, MARKET_OPEN, POST_MARKET, SLEEPING, LEARNING, RECOVERING), automatic transitions based on market hours, integration with feedback_loop and daily_cycle.
Integrated XP in feedback_loop.py: added pain_score/xp_impact to Lesson dataclass, added _update_xp_from_closed_trades() method, updated render_for_bob() to include XP context.
Added pain_score and xp_impact fields to Lesson for XP system integration.

risks: Lifecycle loop needs extensive testing before production 24/7 operation
Market hours detection needs timezone accuracy verification (DST, holidays)
XP pain factors need calibration based on real trading performance
No auto-execution yet - Bob still requires manual trigger for trades
No pain memory system yet - traumas are tracked but not weighted in decisions
next_step: Phase 2 (Reinforcement Learning): Implement pain_memory.py with weighted recall, auto_calibration.py for parameter tuning, and rl_loop.py for Q-learning based on trade outcomes.
